_about: Shared redaction fixtures. Run against relayer/src/lib/redact.ts AND the browser copy (<script id="redact-core"> in app/index.html and app/artifact.html). expect = exact redacted text; counts lists only non-zero kinds; every case must also be idempotent.

cases.name: phone (NANP and international)
cases.expect: Call me at [phone hidden] or [phone hidden]

cases.name: links removed whole, never shortened to a domain
cases.expect: go to [link hidden · not opened] or [link hidden · not opened]

cases.name: long number (one-time code)
cases.input: Your code is 834921. Do not share.
cases.expect: Your code is [number hidden]. Do not share.

cases.name: names after greeting and intro; company
cases.input: Hi Jordan, this is Casey from Northwind Bank.
cases.expect: Hi [name hidden], this is [name hidden] from [company hidden].

cases.name: title + name; company
cases.input: Dear Ms. Rivera, your parcel from Speedy Logistics is waiting
cases.expect: Dear Ms. [name hidden], your parcel from [company hidden] is waiting

cases.name: intro with full name
cases.input: I'm Taylor Brooks and I can double your money
cases.expect: I'm [name hidden] and I can double your money

cases.name: already redacted text is unchanged (idempotent)
cases.input: Hi [name hidden], reply YES to [phone hidden].
cases.expect: Hi [name hidden], reply YES to [phone hidden].

cases.name: browser missed a link and a phone: second pass catches them
cases.input: Hi [name hidden], pay at secure-pay.example.top or call 555.987.6543
cases.expect: Hi [name hidden], pay at [link hidden · not opened] or call [phone hidden]

cases.name: stop words are not names
cases.input: Good morning my queen. Hi there!
cases.expect: Good morning my queen. Hi there!

cases.name: days and times are kept
cases.input: Reminder: your cleaning is Tue at 3:00 PM. Reply C to confirm.
cases.expect: Reminder: your cleaning is Tue at 3:00 PM. Reply C to confirm.

cases.name: day after 'From' is not a name
cases.input: Meet me Friday. From Monday on I'm free.
cases.expect: Meet me Friday. From Monday on I'm free.
